synthesisReport.summary: The hypothesis that security specialists and IT executives from the corporate sector are concerned about data leaks when using LLM at work is supported by comments from professional communities, where users express fear of data leaks and fines, and a need for security tools and solutions. However, the assumption that at least 30 security specialists and IT executives will fill out the questionnaire within 72 hours is not supported by the comments, which indicate a lack of willingness to participate in anonymous surveys. The comments also suggest that users are seeking honest feedback and advice on security issues, but are skeptical about the effectiveness of security tools and solutions.
recommendations: Conduct surveys or short questionnaires on willingness and expectations to gather more information about the target audience's concerns and needs.
Consider offering a non-anonymous survey or a more engaging format to increase participation and gather more accurate feedback.
Develop a more effective communication strategy to address the skepticism and concerns about security tools and solutions expressed by users in the comments.
Pivot the project to focus on developing a security tool or solution that addresses the specific concerns and needs expressed by users in the comments, rather than relying on anonymous surveys.

projectName: PII Guardian for SMB HR Agencies
projectHypothesis: If we post in professional communities (LinkedIn InfoSec groups, Telegram channels for CISO, SecurityStack forums and Reddit r/cybersecurity) with a call to take an anonymous survey (3 questions) about real incidents or concerns related to data leaks when using LLM at work, and offer to share the survey results with all participants, then within 72 hours at least 30 security specialists and IT executives from the corporate sector will fill out the questionnaire, and at least 50% of them will confirm that they have encountered leaks or seriously fear such risks, because companies are actively looking for ways to prevent leaks and fines, and the target audience is ready to discuss security issues in professional channels to stay aware of threats and solutions.

assumptionAssessments.evidence: Of 111 comments, ~61 match the topic of this assumption, indicating that companies really suffer from data leaks when using LLM or are very afraid of such risks.
Of 111 comments, ~48 match the topic of this assumption, showing that people who deal with security in companies are aware of this problem and are looking for its solution.
Of 111 comments, ~53 match the topic of this assumption, indicating that these people actively read professional forums and are willing to spend time filling out surveys from strangers.
While ~73 comments match the topic of this assumption, there is no direct evidence to confirm that we will be able to create a product that solves this problem better than existing options.
While ~50 comments match the topic of this assumption, there is no direct evidence to confirm that these people are willing to communicate further with us to learn about a possible solution.
